name: Black Grimoire
desc:
An RPG inspired by Black Clover created by https://www.roblox.com/users/268484532/profile
Some models created by https://www.roblox.com/users/1171317359/profile
Grimoires, dungeons, races, PvP, ranking and more.

Join the group NikkiDZN for a +1% luck boost (+2% on weekends).
https://www.roblox.com/groups/3885445/NikkiDZN
Use the tag "BG_" or "_BG" for an extra +3% luck boost.

🌪️ Grimoires include:
Light, Anti, Ice, Undead Corpses, Mirror, Wind, Dark Light, Water, Time, Dark, Lightning, Blood, Spatial, Imitation, Thread, Plant, Fire, Earth

(You can get one at the Grimoire Tower)

⚔️ Dungeons spawn randomly with enemies and loot.

✨ Races: Human, Dwarf, Elf, Lesser Devil
🏅 Classes: Peasant, Noble, Royalty, Witch

Play however you want: solo, party, grind, fight.
